vuln.name: HTTPS connection uses outdated TLS version
vuln.description: Acunetix could not establish a SSL/TLS connection using a TLS version of 1.2 or better. This is a strong indicator of the server supporting only outdated, unsupported, and potentially insecure versions of SSL/TLS.
vuln.impact: The connection may be intercepted and possibly decrypted by a third party.
vuln.recommendation: The server should support TLS 1.2 or better.

reference.title: Testing for Weak SSL/TSL Ciphers, Insufficient Transport Layer Protection
